settings.label: Show shipping progress in drawer

settings.label: Legacy: Show add-ons in drawer

settings.label: Legacy: Enable Lottie/SVG animations
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. No global Lottie renderer is installed. Add animation through a supported app or section.

settings.label: Allow legacy custom code
settings.info: Controls the three code fields below. Existing code stays enabled for compatibility. These fields run trusted HTML/JavaScript without consent handling. Prefer app embeds; configure tracking through Shopify pixels.

settings.label: Legacy custom code: head
settings.info: Advanced: trusted code only. Runs on storefront pages, including Theme Editor previews. Never paste secrets. This is not a pixel or consent manager. Blank or none outputs nothing.

settings.label: Legacy custom code: body start
settings.info: Advanced: trusted code only. Runs on storefront pages, including Theme Editor previews. Never paste secrets. This is not a pixel or consent manager. Blank or none outputs nothing.

settings.label: Legacy custom code: body end
settings.info: Advanced: trusted code only. Runs on storefront pages, including Theme Editor previews. Never paste secrets. This is not a pixel or consent manager. Blank or none outputs nothing.

settings.label: Legacy: GA4 Measurement ID
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Configure analytics in the provider app or Shopify customer events/pixels. This field does not install tracking.

settings.label: Legacy: Meta Pixel ID
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Configure analytics in the provider app or Shopify customer events/pixels. This field does not install tracking.

settings.label: Legacy: TikTok Pixel ID
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Configure analytics in the provider app or Shopify customer events/pixels. This field does not install tracking.

settings.label: Legacy form consent metadata
settings.info: Sends metadata to configured form handlers only. Does not add a checkbox, opt a customer in, or change Shopify tracking consent. Newsletter confirmation remains explicit.

settings.label: Legacy: Consent default checked (if optional)
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Newsletter forms own their explicit signup confirmation. This does not control Shopify customer privacy consent.

settings.label: Legacy: Consent label
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Newsletter forms own their explicit signup confirmation. This does not control Shopify customer privacy consent.

settings.label: Bulk-order default destination
settings.info: Only used by Bulk order when its destination is Global default. Both legacy custom choices post to the configured endpoint; they do not render HTML or Liquid. Other forms own their destination.

settings.label: Custom form CAPTCHA default
settings.info: Used only when a custom-endpoint form inherits this choice. Explicit section choices, including None, win. Shopify protects its native forms separately. Your server must verify custom tokens.

settings.label: Public CAPTCHA site key
settings.info: For the selected global provider. Section keys and retained provider-specific legacy keys take priority. Enter a public browser site key only; keep verification secrets on your server. Blank or none disables the key.

settings.label: Legacy: reCAPTCHA v3 threshold (×100)
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Your endpoint must verify scores server-side. The theme does not enforce this threshold.

settings.label: Default hidden tags
settings.info: Base tags for supported forms; section tags are appended. Tags do not subscribe customers or configure an external app.

settings.label: Default custom endpoint (optional)
settings.info: HTTPS or store-relative POST endpoint for custom forms. Local destinations take priority. Configure validation, token verification, consent and delivery on your server. Never include secrets in this URL.

settings.label: Enable optional Google Maps loader
settings.info: Locator sections also require their local map switch and a public key. Enabling loads Google automatically. This is not visitor consent. Review provider privacy requirements; native location cards work without Google.

settings.label: Google Maps API key (public)
settings.info: Public browser key for enabled locator sections. Restrict it to your storefront and required APIs with Google. Never enter a server secret.

settings.label: Legacy: Default latitude
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Map sections own their coordinates; these global coordinates are not used.

settings.label: Legacy: Default longitude
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Map sections own their coordinates; these global coordinates are not used.

settings.label: Map banner fallback zoom
settings.info: Fallback for the Service area map banner when its local zoom is missing. Locator sections use their own zoom.

settings.label: Preview popup in Theme Editor
settings.info: Opens once per preview render without storing frequency. Works while the storefront popup is disabled. Close it normally to continue editing.

settings.label: Legacy: Popup type
settings.info: Retained for compatibility; no effect. Content, newsletter visibility and trigger controls below determine behavior. Age gate never verified age or restricted access.

settings.label: Popup trigger
settings.info: Exit intent works on desktop pointer exit only. First visit uses browser storage only when Shopify permits preference storage; otherwise it lasts for this page. Manual uses a configured popup opener.

settings.label: Popup frequency
settings.info: Automatic display occurs at most once per page. Session/day/week memory requires Shopify preference permission and usable browser storage; otherwise page memory only. Manual open bypasses frequency. This is not tracking consent.

settings.label: Popup animation
settings.info: Reduced-motion preferences disable movement. None opens and closes without transitions.

settings.label: Popup text
settings.default: Get updates, offers, and helpful store news delivered occasionally.

settings.label: Show newsletter form
settings.info: Native Shopify newsletter signup with explicit email marketing confirmation. Does not install an email app or change Shopify tracking consent.

settings.label: Popup style
settings.info: Minimal hides the image; Commerce adjusts heading measure. Width, padding and colors below apply to every style.

settings.label: Popup radius
settings.info: Fullscreen uses square screen edges; other placements use this radius.

settings.label: Popup width
settings.info: Maximum dialog width; constrained by the screen. Fullscreen fills the screen. Side images stack on smaller screens.

settings.label: Popup padding
settings.info: Content padding. Extra space at the top keeps the close button clear of the heading.

settings.label: Font loading strategy
settings.info: Swap shows fallback text immediately. Fallback limits the font swap period. Legacy async uses swap; it is not a separate loader.

settings.label: Preconnect hosts (comma-separated)
settings.info: Comma-separated HTTPS origins. Invalid entries and duplicates are ignored; paths are reduced to their origin. Avoid unused connections.

settings.label: Show country/region selector
settings.info: Footers One, Three and Four. Shopify Markets controls available countries and currencies. Footers Two and Five use their local controls.

settings.label: Show language selector
settings.info: Footers One, Three and Four; shown when multiple languages are available. Footers Two and Five use their local controls.

settings.label: Enable RTL styles
settings.info: Use right-to-left document direction for supported RTL locales. Does not translate content. Review custom sections in each target locale.

settings.label: Language switcher style
settings.info: Shared selector appearance in Footers One, Three and Four.
